about_the_game:
Rune Dungeon is a strategy game that combines auto-battler mechanics with roguelike elements.

Recruit heroes, equip powerful equipment, and unlock ancient rune powers to form unique team synergies.

Face waves of enemies and descend into the depths of the dungeon to challenge the legendary Demon Lord.

  • Unique Heroes

    Each hero has distinct abilities and passive abilities—ranging from high single-target damage and AoE attacks to healing, defense, control, acceleration, and growth.

    Build your squad wisely by selecting suitable heroes, equipping them with synergistic equipment and runes.

    Even heroes of the same class may vary slightly in stats, leading to diverse strategies each run.

  • A Wide Variety of Equipment

    Dozens or even hundreds of well-designed items enhance various aspects of your team: health, attack, damage dealt, healing power, energy generation, and ultimate skill strength.
    Many items interact with one another for greater synergy, such as:

    • Healing + Enhanced Healing

    • Energy Generation + Boosted Ultimate Strength

    Occasionally, you’ll discover powerful epic equipment that causes dramatic power spikes.
    Even basic items can be upgraded, ensuring every piece remains relevant throughout the game.

  • Empowering Rune System

    In the depths of the dungeon, discover mysterious runes that grant powerful effects:

    • Break energy limits

    • Increase max equipment enhancement levels

    • Allow heroes to act multiple times

    • Gain bonus gold
      These runes drastically shift the way your team functions and open new tactical possibilities.

  • Adapt, Strategize, and Conquer

    Choose your team, equip them well, activate runes, and adjust your formation in battle.

    Overcome enemy waves one by one, and ultimately face the final boss in the heart of the dungeon.

    Every run is a fresh challenge that tests your strategy and adaptability.
